title: At a minimal prime exactly one cohomology module of a dualizing complex is nonzero
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file dualizing.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement says that if A is a Noetherian ring and p a minimal prime, then the localized cohomology modules H^i(omega_A^bullet)_p of a dualizing complex vanish for all but exactly one i (author lemma at source lines 3448-3452, label lemma-nonvanishing-generically). The proof (source lines 3455-3462) localizes the dualizing complex to the local ring at p, where it stays dualizing, observes that this local ring has dimension zero because p is minimal, and invokes the description of dualizing complexes over such a ring, where exactly one cohomology module is nonzero. The localization step and the dimension observation are the substance. H2.
